case_name: Maj Pankaj Rai Retd Pankaj Rai v. The State Of Telangana, Rep.,Pp

parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Telangana, respondent No.2/de facto complainant (wife)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife stayed only for 33 days and left without valid reasons, petitioner claims second marriage is nullity due to pending appeal in first husband's divorce case.

legal_principles.principle: A second marriage by either party shall be lawful only after dismissal of an appeal against the decree of divorce, if filed.
legal_principles.held: Section 15 of the Act provides that it shall be lawful for either party to marry again after dissolution of a marriage if there is no right of appeal against the decree. A second marriage by either party shall be lawful only after dismissal of an appeal against the decree of divorce, if filed.
cited_cases: Maj Pankaj Rai Retd Pankaj Rai vs The State Of Telangana.,Rep.,Pp on 9 April, 2019
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — to ensure that the said appeal is not frustrated

legal_principles.principle: The object of Section 15 of the Act is to provide protection to the person who has filed an appeal against the decree of dissolution of marriage and to ensure that the said appeal is not frustrated.
